title: The Kimball house's tower wears its turned finial, its dormers their slate
items: 1801 Prairie's corner tower now carries the knobbed, turned finial of the c. 1895 Taylor photograph, rising from a crocketed collar on the cone's tip, in pale metal where a plain slate spike stood.
The house's three hooded dormers have slated faces with a pale frame round each small window, as the Taylor photograph and the 1965 HABS photograph show them, where their faces were plain stone.
